title: ImplementationRecord
description: A record in the closed BANZA Technical Registry for an IMPLEMENTATION — the technical system actually evaluated (ADR-038 §4.2/§13). One operator may publish many implementations (demonstration, sandbox, pre-production, production; different versions, profiles, capabilities and deployments). The validation target is always an operator AND one of its published implementations — never the entity in the abstract. An origin-less, unpublished, revoked or incompatible implementation is not an eligible target (ADR-038 §14 Consequences). Documentary/reference contract — mirrors the Rust `banza-target-registry` ImplementationRecord; it introduces no new financial invariant.
_authority: ADR-038 (endpoint-originated operator validation & operator–implementation model), ADR-036 (technical registry), ADR-043 (Rust-first engines)
_boundary: The record names a technical target and its public endpoints. It is not certification, scheme admission, or regulatory authorisation, and it never lets any entity move funds.

implementation_id.description: Stable implementation identifier (e.g. 'operator-zero-ref-impl'). The subject actually evaluated.

operator_id.description: The operator that publishes this implementation. Must match an OperatorRecord that lists this implementation_id.

protocol_version.description: BANZA protocol version this implementation targets (e.g. '1.0.0'). Must be supported by the registry to be eligible.

profile.description: Conformance profile (scope level) the implementation is published for.

environment.description: Environment eligible for endpoint-originated validation. Never production / real-money at this baseline.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the implementation declares (descriptive, not a grant).

canonical_origin.description: The implementation's canonical public HTTPS origin (e.g. 'https://zero.banza.network'). An empty/missing origin makes the implementation an ineligible (origin-less) target. The secure fetcher pins the host to this origin (ADR-038 §4.7).

endpoints.description: The 14 canonical published paths of the implementation (relative, leading-slash). Resolution joins each onto `canonical_origin`.

publication_status.description: Lifecycle state. Only 'published' is an eligible validation target.

evidence_refs.description: References (e.g. ADR ids) supporting the record. Never verdict-bearing.
